annotations.title: Create a flyer from a prompt

description: Generate a one- or two-sided flyer (poster, event, promo) from a text prompt: one model call plans the copy (headline, kicker, venue, CTA) and — unless generateImage:false — one hero image, then buildFlyer composes it at the chosen size and Style. The flyer analogue of generate_deck, the SAME pipeline the web's flyer screen uses. Returns the new artifact id: read/edit it with read_artifact, redraw it with reroll_artifact, download it with export_artifact. Any free-tier degradation (the AI-image budget ran out, so the flyer kept a styled placeholder) comes back as a warning — never a silent downgrade.

archetype.description: Flyer layout (see language_reference kind:flyer). Default poster-hero.

direction.description: Free-form creative direction for the outline

generateImage.description: Generate a hero image (default true). false keeps the archetype's styled placeholder.

prompt.description: What the flyer is for — the event/offer, audience, and key details

seed.description: Reproducible draw; the same seed + Style gives the same flyer.

sizePreset.description: Letter | A4 | A5 | poster-tabloid | square | story. Default Letter.

styleId.description: A curated Style id from list_styles (e.g. riso-pop). Default the first curated Style.

name: create_flyer
